tactics:
intro α p l f g hf
induction l with
| nil => simp
| cons a l ih => cases a; simp_all [List.filter_cons]; split <;> simp_all
intro α p l f g hf
: intro α p l f g hf <;> induction l <;> simp_all [List.filter_cons]
intros <;> rename_i hf <;> induction ‹List _› <;> simp_all [List.filter_cons] <;> split <;> simp_all
intro α p l f g hf <;> induction l with | nil => rfl | cons a l ih => (obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := a; simp only [List.filter_cons, hf]; split <;> simp_all)
